title: Route alias lacks regression coverage
reasoning: The feature exposes hub URLs under the /api/ prefix, but the review bundle includes no tests for URL resolution or representative requests through this alias. Because this is a public network-facing API route, a future URL ordering change or include removal could silently break clients using /api/ while leaving the existing /hub/ route intact.
recommendation: Add a focused URL routing test that verifies at least one known hub endpoint resolves and responds through the /api/ prefix, not only through /hub/.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the excerpt only shows the route declaration.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a Django URL resolver or client test for a representative hub endpoint under /api/, asserting it resolves to the expected hub view and returns the expected status.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change covering the /api/ include in bahk/urls.py.
